channel.title: Lisa Hartouni — Blog
channel.description: News, updates, and press about Lisa Hartouni's photography and community projects.

item.title: Moon Series — October 2026
item.description: A new sequence from Lisa Hartouni's ongoing Moon Photography Series — five photographs of the crescent moon, October 2026.

item.title: Fundraiser Update
item.description: The campaign has raised $515 of the $2,000 goal. A busy week of cleanup and rebuilding — the team has been scrubbing the compromised sites and switching from WordPress to HTML.

item.title: Website Recovery Update
item.description: An update from Lisa: the malware cleanup is underway on both the front and back end of the affected sites. Lisa is focused on the $2,000 initial goal — every donation and share helps move the needle.

item.title: GoFundMe Campaign: Help Sustain Lisa Hartouni's Work
item.description: The campaign is live. Here is what it is raising for, where the money goes, and every way to give or share -- including Venmo and PayPal options and Lisa's own updates posted to GoFundMe.

item.title: Some Very Welcome News From UCLA
item.description: UCLA Alumni featured Lisa's work in their Class Notes, covering the cyberattacks, the GoFundMe campaign, and the From Here to Manzanar project.

item.title: Slow and Steady
item.description: A GoFundMe update from Lisa thanking early contributors and sharing her goal of raising $3,000 in seed money to rebuild her website structure.

item.title: Looking Back: The 2014 Press-Telegram Feature on My INS Detention Centers Photographs
item.description: A look back at a 2014 Press-Telegram feature on Lisa's INS Detention Centers photo series, documenting a 1987 immigration detention facility at the Mardi Gras Motel in Inglewood.

item.title: Looking Back: My Work in the LA Times' 1993 "Portraits From the Street" Review
item.description: A look back at a 1993 Los Angeles Times review of the group exhibit Intersecciones/Intersections at McGroarty Arts Center, which featured Lisa's INS detention-center photographs.

item.title: Good Morning, Long Beach
item.description: A note from Lisa thanking early donors to her GoFundMe campaign and explaining why restoring her web presence matters to the people who rely on it.

item.title: Lisa's First Donation Is In — Thank You, Boost Board
item.description: Lisa Hartouni's GoFundMe campaign received its first donation, and Boost Board featured her as today's spotlighted campaign.

item.title: Long Beach Photojournalist's 40 Years of Social-Justice Work Was Hacked — Now She's Fighting to Rebuild It
item.description: Lisa Hartouni has launched a GoFundMe campaign to rebuild her web presence after a series of malware attacks, and to build sustainable infrastructure for her ongoing photography and archival projects.

item.title: Jack Is Home (Jack made international news!)
item.description: A short note of gratitude after Lisa's German shepherd and service dog, Jack, was safely returned three weeks after being stolen from her Long Beach yard.
